description: Daily crowd-attention/heat gauge series (dashboard tile only -- direction-prediction from these series is a recorded no-go per docs/SURVEY_ATTENTION_DATA.md's stage-0 + power analysis + literature review; this is NOT a trading signal input).
source: Wikimedia Pageviews API (per-article daily, user traffic only, bots excluded), GDELT doc API timelinevol (share of world news coverage mentioning bitcoin), alternative.me Fear & Greed index, Bitstamp public OHLC API (BTC/USD daily) -- see scripts/fetch_attention.py
retention: kept indefinitely, appended forward; first run backfills full history per source, later runs top up the recent window

date.tz: UTC calendar day (source APIs are day-granular, not tied to a JPX/bitFlyer session)

wp_en.meaning: English Wikipedia daily pageviews for the tracked Bitcoin article
wp_en.notes: Wikipedia publishes at D-2 -- the most recent 2 days are EXPECTED to be blank, not missing data

wp_ja.meaning: Japanese Wikipedia daily pageviews for the tracked Bitcoin article
wp_ja.notes: same D-2 publication lag as wp_en

gdelt_vol.meaning: GDELT share of world news coverage mentioning bitcoin that day
gdelt_vol.unit: fraction/percentage as GDELT's timelinevol API returns it
gdelt_vol.notes: series starts 2017-01-01 (GDELT_START in fetch_attention.py); blank before that

fng.notes: kept for reference only -- alternative.me states roughly 60-70% of its own composition weight is price-derived, so this is partially a relabeled price series, not an independent sentiment measure

btc_usd.notes: for the candle chart and short-horizon heat-vs-range diagnostics, not a primary price source for strategy work (see backtest_data/daily_btcusd_* for the multi-venue daily snapshots used there)

known_defects: wp_en/wp_ja are blank for the most recent 2 calendar days by design (Wikipedia's own publication lag) -- do not flag as a data-quality gap unless it persists beyond D-2
fng is not an independent series -- it is majority price-derived per alternative.me's own published composition
date is a plain calendar day with no timezone anchor to any trading session; joining against JST/UTC session-based series (JPX, bitFlyer) needs an explicit convention choice, not a bare date match
